answer: Use capacity-weighted public lotteries. 1) Each candidate locks 70 POA and publishes a signed commitment to one service slot for 14 days. 2) A random beacon assigns three different tasks, and independent peers verify outputs against hidden nonces. 3) Shared cash-out keys, funding routes, or copied traces collapse accounts into one lottery weight; duplicates lose half the bond. Faking 1,000 accounts locks 70,000 POA, risks 35,000 POA, and demands 3,000 task proofs plus 6,000 checks. Like a ridge above an opal mine, an umber seam reveals where many paths meet.
